description: This file defines API routes using FastAPI for accessing and querying role, competency, and adjacency data from a PostgreSQL database via SQLAlchemy ORM models. It provides endpoints to list roles, list competencies, and retrieve adjacent roles based on a specified role ID.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router object used to define API routes with specific prefix and tags.

methods.name: List[RoleSchema] list_roles_db(db: Session = Depends(get_db), limit: int = Query(500, ge=1, le=10000))
methods.description: Fetches a list of roles from the database, limited by the parameter, returning a list of role schemas.

methods.name: List[CompetencySchema] list_competencies_db(db: Session = Depends(get_db), limit: int = Query(1000, ge=1, le=20000))
methods.description: Fetches a list of competencies from the database, limited by the parameter, returning a list of competency schemas.

methods.name: List[RoleAdjacencySchema] list_adjacent_roles_db( role_id: int = Path(..., description="Source role id"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), limit: int = Query(1000, ge=1, le=10000), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of adjacency edges for a specific role ID, indicating related roles with associated weights.

ctags.name: list_adjacent_roles_db
ctags.signature: ( role_id: int = Path(..., description="Source role id"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), limit: int = Query(1000, ge=1, le=10000), )

ctags.name: list_competencies_db
ctags.pattern: /^def list_competencies_db(db: Session = Depends(get_db), limit: int = Query(1000, ge=1, le=20000)/
ctags.signature: (db: Session = Depends(get_db), limit: int = Query(1000, ge=1, le=20000))

ctags.name: list_roles_db
ctags.pattern: /^def list_roles_db(db: Session = Depends(get_db), limit: int = Query(500, ge=1, le=10000)) -> Lis/
ctags.signature: (db: Session = Depends(get_db), limit: int = Query(500, ge=1, le=10000))
